conditions: Valid construct or conforming implementation under the cited ECMA-367 second-edition clause.
limitations: The triggering condition includes later evaluation of the associated variable. The rule establishes no exception from a variable that is never evaluated and no implementation strategy.

triggers: Publisher correction, materially revised edition, source byte drift or contrary applicable evidence.
A change to the BQN draft status or evidence that changes the documented language boundary.

statement: Under ECMA-367 second edition, when evaluation of an effective feature’s postcondition Old expression records an associated exception marker, later evaluation of that expression’s associated variable in a postcondition clause raises OLD_EXCEPTION.
